quest_clear_as_glass_step_2.name: Arian's Secret Office (Highwatch Library)
quest_clear_as_glass_step_2.context:
[Step 2] In Highwatch Library:
1. Press button near top of stairs at [1180, 145, -128] to open bookshelf door at [1189, 136, -136].
2. Defeat Shady Thief inside office (1183, 137, -133).
3. Click hidden button behind south painting to open east wall bookcase chest containing 'Elegy of My Dearest Friend'.

quest_clear_as_glass_step_3.name: Arian (Lonely Stranger - Farr)

quest_clear_as_glass_step_4.name: Nelfine (Secret Cave Return)
quest_clear_as_glass_step_4.context: [Step 4] Return to Nelfine's cave in Sierhaven. She has lost her memories again and does not recognize you, but gives you 'Letter to Arian' found at her feet. | Objective: Arian doesn't seem to believe you. You should probably return to Nelfine.

quest_clear_as_glass_step_5.name: Arian (Farr Letter Return)
quest_clear_as_glass_step_5.context: [Step 5] Return to Arian in Farr with the note. He recognizes her handwriting and asks you to use the device from Overgrown Laboratory again to restore her memories. | Objective: Nelfine has no memory of you! Return to Arian with the note she gave you.

quest_clear_as_glass_step_6.name: Overgrown Laboratory (Chest)
quest_clear_as_glass_step_6.context: [Step 6] Head to Overgrown Laboratory POI (335, 79, 303). The old lab is destroyed! Loot chest at (375, 72, 482) to obtain 'A Miraculous Breakthrough' with clues pointing to Moist Ruins. | Objective: Find your way back to the Overgrown Laboratory and see if you can restore Nelfine's memories once again. | [What to do] Head to the Overgrown Laboratory at (335, 79, 303). Take A Miraculous Breakthrough from the chest at (375, 72, 482).

quest_clear_as_glass_step_7.name: Moist Ruins (Secret Lab Tunnel)

[Step 7] Head to Moist Ruins POI (829, 77, -205) and enter tunnel at bottom [824, 25, -218].
Enter secret chamber at [797, 29, -217] where Virius trapped Nelfine in a mind probe.
Correct dialogue answers: 1: [Blossomed], 2: [Lets her leave], 3: [Wait for Arian].

quest_clear_as_glass_step_8.name: Virius (Boss Fight)
